primaryComparisonDecisions.decision: Current けれど／けれども moved from snapshot entry1004200 to entry2853889; manuscript uses the current identity.
Official XML permitsつゆ with汁 for soup/broth. Snapshot restriction differed; keep the valid alternative using primary source evidence.
Currentあさげ is separate entry2863028, which explicitly lists朝食 and breakfast. Same-meaning alternative accepted with that specific source; obsoleteあさけ excluded.
Currentおんじょう is entry2872608: human voice sense1 accepted, gagaku music sense2 excluded. Not a global alternative for all meanings of音声.
Current XML confirmsかがん only with河岸; 川岸 keepsかわぎし.
Current XML search-onlyみぎっかわ／ひだりっかわ are not promoted to ordinary reading answers.

semanticBoundaries: ただ is a qualifying conjunction, not free of charge or merely; まるで is simile, not completely.
その場 examples teach immediate handling on the spot; まとめる gathers physical items, not text summaries.
値 means measured/calculated value; 丸 is circle, not yen; 市 is marketいち, not cityし.
正す trains posture/collar adjustment, not text correction, interrogation or identification.
夜行 trains night travel, including bus service, not only a night train; やぎょう not accepted in this target.
札 usesふだ for labels/signs; oldふみた／ふんだ and banknoteさつ excluded.
受領 does not imply approval; 応募 does not imply acceptance or winning.
手をつなぐ and 電話を切る are sourced lexical phrases with independent contexts, not physical object-connection or cutting.
縫う, 潰す, 盛る, 染める and 無線 retain their explicitly selected physical/action senses.
No inferred pitch accents added; missing accent data does not become a flat pattern.
